title: Lightly Grilled Thai Pork Moo Ping
description: A bitter, snappy, and savory Thai street food dish featuring grilled pork skewers, dry white wine, and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, perfect for midnight cravings. This Whole30-friendly recipe is cooked in a copper pot.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together dry white wine, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, grind-rice-khao-khua, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork shoulder to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated pork slices onto skewers, if using.
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the pork skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the grilled pork to a copper pot and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Serve the moo ping hot, garnished with additional grind-rice-khao-khua and lime wedges, if desired.
